name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. Per-method inventory distinguishes public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and omissions. The current reviewed tuple provides calculations, environment/unit and editor metadata, exact-target PCB layers and identities, Line/Arc/Via geometry, Component metadata, Pad placement and round/slot hole details. Unfiltered and explicit-ID reads retain complete-family checks. Component child-pad lists correlate native child IDs with global Pad DTOs and report reverse ownership and schematic pin mapping as unverified. Geometry uses bounded native observations; copper shapes, rules and library enrichment remain incomplete. Ordinary existing-profile launch, retained-owner window observation and one-shot normal closure support disposable project/PCB opening. Closure never chooses Save/Discard or forces exit; acknowledgment and retained termination are separate. Opening requires an empty registered editor, selected registered local file, checkpoint-member PCB and retained ordinary launch. Normal opening can migrate storage and automatically Save. Inspection never replays navigation; lost handles and quarantine remain restricted. Historical abandonment qualifies specific retained evidence without granting process or design authority. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The older tuple retains guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Schematic-page, symbol and PCB transactions plus eight metadata writers remain blocked pending native structure-job completion and complete SQL-effect proof. Compiled topology and affected exports refuse hidden annotation or Save All. Connected validation is operation- and generation-specific. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save remain refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
